CirclesPart 3 · Circles inside circles
Circle word problems

Two circles inside a big circle

A small circle (radius r) and a middle circle (radius 2r) touch each other. They fit exactly inside a big circle. The shaded part is the big circle without the two smaller circles. Use π = 22/7.

6

r = 7 cm. Find the shaded area.

Say it first: is the shaded part more than half or less than half of the big circle?
small radius = 7 cm,  middle radius = cm,  big radius = cm
big circle area = 22/7 × × = cm²
small + middle circle areas = + = cm²
Shaded area cm²
Wrap-up Day · Circles8
CirclesPart 3 · Circles inside circles
Circle word problems

Work backwards: find 2r

Same picture as number 6: circles of radius r and 2r inside a big circle. Now we know the shaded area and work backwards.

7

The shaded area is 616 cm². Find 2r.

Hint: write every area as "some number × πr²".
big = π × × = × πr²
small = 1 × πr²    middle = π × 2r × 2r = × πr²
shaded = × πr² = 616
2r = cm
8

Challenge: the shaded area is 2,464 cm². Find 2r.

2r = cm
Trap! Find the big radius first: the big diameter = the two small diameters added together. Then square the whole radius.

ElectricityPart 4 · Exam practice
Electricity

Short circuits and house lights

Short circuitA wire gives the current an easy path around a bulb or straight back to the cell. The current skips the bulb. If the wire goes straight across the cell, the current becomes very big, the wire gets hot, and it can start a fire.
E6

aThe bulb gets brighter.
bNothing changes.
cThe bulb goes out and the wire gets hot.
dThe cell charges up.

Equations: keep the balance

An equation is a balance. Both sides weigh the same.

The rule: whatever you do to one side, do the same to the other side.

+ undoes −   × undoes ÷

Say it first: how many weights are inside the box?

x + 3 = 8

x has

take away 3 from both sides: x + 3 − 3 = 8 −

4Check
+ 3 = 8 ✓

x − 6 = 9

x has
2Undo it on both sides
add to both sides
3x =
4Check
− 6 = 9 ✓

Two-step equations

Two steps: undo in reverse order.Getting dressed: socks on, then shoes. Getting undressed: shoes off first, then socks. In 2x + 5, x was × 2 first, then + 5. So undo + 5 first, then × 2.
